tasks.title: Detect Standard Linter
tasks.prompt: Extend detectLint in src/gates/detect.cjs to detect standard when standard is present in dependencies or devDependencies of package.json. Return { available: true, command: 'npx standard --verbose', reason: null } when no higher priority linter (cfg.lintCommand, @biomejs/biome) is configured.

tasks.title: Detect Ruff Linter
tasks.prompt: Extend detectLint in src/gates/detect.cjs to detect ruff when ruff is in dependencies/devDependencies or ruff.toml exists in cwd. Return { available: true, command: 'ruff check --output-format=json .', reason: null } when no higher priority linter is configured.
tasks.description: Detect ruff linter via config or dependencies

tasks.title: Detect Jest Test Runner
tasks.prompt: Extend detectTest in src/gates/detect.cjs to detect jest in dependencies/devDependencies. Return { available: true, command: 'npx jest --json', reason: null } when vitest and cfg.testCommand are not configured.
tasks.description: Detect jest test runner in dependencies

tasks.title: Detect Mocha Test Runner
tasks.prompt: Extend detectTest in src/gates/detect.cjs to detect mocha in dependencies/devDependencies. Return { available: true, command: 'npx mocha --reporter json', reason: null } when vitest and cfg.testCommand are not configured.
tasks.description: Detect mocha test runner in dependencies

tasks.title: Detect Pyright / Mypy Typecheckers
tasks.prompt: Extend detectTypecheck in src/gates/detect.cjs to detect pyright when pyrightconfig.json exists in cwd (command: 'pyright') and mypy when mypy.ini exists in cwd (command: 'mypy .') when no higher priority typechecker is configured.
tasks.description: Detect pyright or mypy typecheckers via config files

tasks.title: Export hasAnyDep Helper
tasks.prompt: Implement and export hasAnyDep(manifest, names) in src/gates/detect.cjs that returns true if any dependency in the names array is present in dependencies or devDependencies of manifest, and false otherwise.
tasks.description: Export hasAnyDep(manifest, names) helper in detect.cjs

tasks.title: Parse ESLint JSON Output
tasks.prompt: Implement and export parseEslintJson(raw) in src/gates/parse.cjs that parses ESLint JSON output array and returns an array of normalized error objects { file, line, column, code, message }. Return null or empty array on invalid JSON.

tasks.title: Parse Jest JSON Results
tasks.prompt: Implement and export parseJestJson(raw) in src/gates/parse.cjs that parses Jest --json output and returns { errors, passing }, extracting failing assertions into errors [{ file, message }] and passing test names into passing string array.

tasks.title: Parse Pytest Test Output
tasks.prompt: Implement and export parsePytest(raw) in src/gates/parse.cjs that parses pytest stdout lines for FAILED and PASSED entries and returns { errors, passing }.

tasks.title: Filter Diagnostics by Code
tasks.prompt: Implement and export filterByCode(errors, ignoredCodes) in src/gates/parse.cjs that returns a new array of errors omitting any error whose code is present in ignoredCodes (array or Set).

tasks.title: Group Diagnostics by File
tasks.prompt: Implement and export groupByFile(errors) in src/gates/parse.cjs that groups an array of error objects by their file property, returning an object mapping file path to array of errors.

tasks.title: Parse Biome JSON Diagnostics
tasks.prompt: Implement and export parseBiomeJson(raw) in src/gates/parse.cjs that parses Biome JSON reporter output ({ diagnostics: [...] }) and returns an array of normalized errors { file, line, column, code, message }.

tasks.title: Track Consecutive Failure in Repair
tasks.prompt: Extend evaluate in src/gates/repair.cjs to include an isConsecutive boolean property on the returned evaluation object, set to true if key matches state.lastFailureKey before state update, and false otherwise.
tasks.description: Track isConsecutive failure flag in repair evaluation

tasks.title: Support Per-Gate Repair Limits
tasks.prompt: Extend evaluate in src/gates/repair.cjs to check cfg.gateMaxRepairs?.[gateName] as the maximum repair attempts for that specific gate before falling back to cfg.maxRepairs.
tasks.description: Support per-gate custom repair limits in repair.cjs

tasks.title: Format Regression Summary
tasks.prompt: Implement and export formatRegressionSummary(regression) in src/gates/repair.cjs returning 'No regressions' if not regressed, or 'REGRESSION: N test(s) failed: name1, name2' when tests have regressed.

tasks.title: Filter Ignored Error Codes in Gate Runner
tasks.prompt: Implement and export filterIgnoredCodes(errors, ignored) in src/gates/run.cjs that filters out errors whose code is contained in the ignored array or set.

tasks.title: Sanitize Shell Commands
tasks.prompt: Implement and export sanitizeCommand(cmd) in src/gates/run.cjs that trims whitespace and throws an Error if disallowed command chaining operators (';', '&&', '||') are present.

tasks.title: Safe Execution with Timeout
tasks.prompt: Implement and export execSafe(command, cwd, timeoutMs) in src/gates/run.cjs returning { out, code, timedOut } capturing stdout/stderr and flagging timedOut: true on process timeout.
tasks.description: Implement execSafe(command, cwd, timeoutMs) in run.cjs

tasks.title: Validate Config Schema
tasks.prompt: Implement and export validateConfig(cfg) in src/core/config.cjs returning { valid: boolean, errors: string[] } checking that numeric config properties are positive numbers and arrays are valid arrays.

tasks.title: Merge Configuration Objects
tasks.prompt: Implement and export mergeConfig(base, overrides) in src/core/config.cjs returning a new configuration object with overrides merged onto base, ignoring undefined override fields.

tasks.title: Support TANDEM_MAX_ERRORS Env Override
tasks.prompt: Extend load(cwd) in src/core/config.cjs to check process.env.TANDEM_MAX_ERRORS (parsed as integer for maxErrorsToModel) and process.env.TANDEM_MAX_REPAIRS (for maxRepairs) when defined.

tasks.title: Normalize Working Set Globs
tasks.prompt: Implement and export normalizeWorkingSet(workingSet) in src/core/config.cjs that trims whitespace, converts backslashes to forward slashes, and deduplicates glob patterns in an array.

tasks.title: Clear Memory Key from State
tasks.prompt: Implement and export clearMemory(state, targetKey) in src/core/state.cjs that removes items matching targetKey from state.memory and resets errorCounts[targetKey], returning count of items removed.

tasks.title: Reset Session State
tasks.prompt: Implement and export resetSession(state) in src/core/state.cjs that resets ephemeral fields (repairCount: 0, lastFailureKey: '', greenTests: [], disabled: {}) while preserving persistent errorCounts and memory.

tasks.title: Diff State Snapshots
tasks.prompt: Implement and export diffState(prevState, nextState) in src/core/state.cjs returning { newGreenTests: string[], lostGreenTests: string[], newLessons: any[] } comparing test outcomes and memories between two states.

tasks.title: Summarize State Metrics
tasks.prompt: Implement and export summarizeState(state) in src/core/state.cjs returning { greenCount, lessonCount, errorCountTotal, repairCount } aggregating session and memory metrics.

tasks.title: Priority for Decision Points
tasks.prompt: Implement and export priorityFor(point) in src/core/decision-points.cjs returning numeric priority integer: DP1_EDIT -> 1, DP2_IMPORT -> 2, DP3_DEPENDENTS -> 3, DP4_FAILURE -> 4, DP5_FINISH -> 5, 0 for unknown.

tasks.title: Filter Decision Points
tasks.prompt: Implement and export filterPoints(points, disabledPoints) in src/core/decision-points.cjs returning an array of points excluding any point found in disabledPoints (array or Set).

tasks.title: Find Dependency Cycles in Graph
tasks.prompt: Implement and export findCycles(graph) in src/context/depgraph.cjs returning an array of detected cycles (e.g. [['a.ts', 'b.ts', 'a.ts']]) or empty array [] if graph is acyclic.

tasks.title: Topological Sort of Dependency Graph
tasks.prompt: Implement and export topologicalSort(graph) in src/context/depgraph.cjs returning an array of file paths ordered dependency-first, or null if circular dependencies exist.
